milestone: Test20: nine original-owner-palette-locked large national flags

algorithm.name: 4bpp original-owner palette locked multiplexing
algorithm.basis: For each source 64x28 tile, preserve the exact 15-bit BGR555 color at every pixel for existing owner by redistributing only matching-index palette aliases. A new national slot gets its own per-slot CLUT to render an approximated new picture, with exact measured per-pixel error bound.
algorithm.selection: Global distinct style assignment via Hungarian algorithm to nine national host templates; no shared club style templates.

includes: CLUT-constrained optimizer source and unit tests

limitations: Only large 64x28 static graphic output of nine new flags verified offline. No fresh Test20 gameplay screenshot.
The nine TARGET national CLUTs are changed. Their small selection and HUD icons are NOT validated and may still be incorrect.
All 45 other nations' CLUT words are unchanged, but 24 club visual runtime audit, other texture variants, carried flags, map, HUD not proven by gameplay.
Existing Test18 prematch large-flag visual problems (Cape Verde/Bosnia) and Bosnia-versus-club54 style collision remain.
Compact names such as C.VERDE remain; all screens not yet approved.
Six low-resolution flags derive from project raster candidates and may need artistic revision.
